title: Roundtrip Shared Tour: Lake Louise, Moraine, Johnston & Emerald
includes: Sighseeing tour in Lake Louise, Moraine Lake and Emerald lake Stop
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Spend a day exploring some of the most beautiful places in the Canadian Rockies. This tour takes you to the iconic Lake Louise, the world-famous Moraine Lake, the scenic waterfalls and walking trails of Johnston Canyon, and the stunning turquoise waters of Emerald Lake. Each stop offers its own unique beauty and plenty of opportunities to take photos, enjoy a short walk, or simply soak in the incredible mountain scenery.

Leave the driving and parking to us while you sit back, relax, and enjoy the journey. With convenient pickup and drop-off, plus time to explore each destination at your own pace, this is an easy and unforgettable way to experience the best of Banff and Yoho National Parks in just one day.
